description: I’m Purva, a backend and AI engineer with a Master’s in Computer Software Engineering from San Jose State. I’ve spent two years building production systems, first at UST on a multi-tenant platform, then at an AI startup where I built LLM workflows and a review platform. My strengths are Python, FastAPI, agent orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock), and getting a messy idea working end to end.
